gaps.sentence: Can we narrow the list ___ to three names?
gaps.explanation: narrow down = reduce the number of possibilities.

gaps.sentence: Who will take ___ from the current director?
gaps.explanation: take over = take control of a job/company.

gaps.sentence: Feel free to drop ___ for a coffee any time.
gaps.explanation: drop in = pay a casual visit; drop off = fall asleep or deliver.

gaps.sentence: The players are gearing ___ for the final.
gaps.explanation: gear up for = prepare for a big event.

gaps.sentence: Don't leave ___ any details in your report.
The match was called ___ because of the storm.
Police are looking ___ the cause of the crash.
They live ___ their pension and a small rent.
gaps.explanation: live off = have as income/food; live on = have as income (money).
